plan.notes: Source: official SAU 2025-2026 Undergraduate Catalog, University Studies Programs section (catalog pp. 261-270; PDF text lines ~17922-18021), 'Bachelor of University Studies (BUS) - Suggested Plan of Study 2025-2026 Catalog'. The BUS degree has no fixed course list: the catalog prints a Suggested Plan of Study built from concentration placeholders (Primary Area of Concentration 30 hours including at least 15 upper-level hours; 2nd Area 12 hours; 3rd Area 12 hours) chosen from the concentration-area course lists; placeholders coded CONC1/CONC2/CONC3, choice=true. World/Global Studies concentration choice coded WGS (part of the 9-hour University Studies Core). Elective placeholders coded ELECTIVE, choice=true. 'X or Y' choice slots use the first-listed option's code. Credit ranges: none present. Category mapping: core = general-education courses/choices; major = university requirement (GSTD 1002), University Studies Core courses (SPCH 1113, USTD 3003, WGS choice), and concentration-area courses; elective = elective slots. EXTRACTION GARBLE (resolved, verified against printed semester totals): in Fall Semester 1 the PDF text interleaves the 4-credit BIOL row with the 3-credit History row (reads 'History choice - must complete one World History | 4'); the 4 belongs to BIOL 1043/1041 Introduction to Biology and Lab (4 credits) and History choice is 3 credits - confirmed by the printed Fall Semester 1 total of 15 (3+3+3+4+2) and by the parallel AA and BUS/MAT plans. No per-course prerequisites are stated in the plan table; external_prereqs is empty.
